categories.main_business_segments: Nexchip Semiconductor Corporation primarily engages in 12-inch wafer foundry services and related supporting services. The company offers wafer foundry across multiple process nodes including 150nm to 55nm in volume production, with small batch production at 40nm and ongoing development at 28nm. Its product portfolio includes Display Driver ICs (DDIC), CMOS Image Sensors (CIS), Power Management ICs (PMIC), Microcontroller Units (MCU), and Logic ICs, serving applications in smartphones, displays, automotive electronics, home appliances, industrial control, and IoT.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced semiconductor manufacturing technologies including copper and aluminum process technologies, BSI (Back Side Illumination) for image sensors, and BCD process for power management chips. It has achieved volume production at mature nodes (150nm to 55nm) and is advancing towards 40nm and 28nm nodes. The manufacturing process includes wafer fabrication, photolithography with mask making, and comprehensive quality control systems. The company also integrates AI technologies into manufacturing and R&D for efficiency and innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nexchip serves leading domestic and international semiconductor design companies and end-product manufacturers. Its products are widely applied in consumer electronics such as smartphones, tablets, and PCs, as well as automotive electronics, industrial automation, security, and IoT devices. The company maintains close relationships with top-tier customers, including some international first-tier companies, and is expanding its presence in automotive and emerging markets like AR/VR and microdisplays.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, headquartered in Hefei, Anhui Province, with subsidiaries including one in Japan. Its customer base and sales cover both domestic and international markets, with significant revenue generated from domestic sales and a growing share from overseas markets. The company actively pursues global market expansion to diversify its geographic footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nexchip operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a wafer foundry service provider. It manufactures wafers for integrated circuit design companies but does not engage in chip design or packaging and testing. The company maintains a robust supply chain with over 1,800 qualified suppliers providing raw materials, equipment, and components, emphasizing supply chain stability and localization to support production needs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on advancing process nodes towards 28nm and beyond, expanding product platforms including OLED display drivers, high-end CIS, PMIC, and automotive-grade chips. It emphasizes innovation in emerging fields such as AI, automotive electronics, micro OLED for AR/VR, and power management. Nexchip also invests in talent development, strategic partnerships, and technology upgrades to maintain competitive advantages and meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Nexchip generates revenue primarily through wafer foundry service contracts, selling manufactured semiconductor wafers to chip design companies. The company operates mainly on a direct sales model, with revenue recognized upon transfer of control of goods at a point in time. It also earns income from related services such as photolithography mask making and receives government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nexchip is ranked ninth globally among wafer foundry companies and third among mainland Chinese wafer foundries. It holds a leading global market share in LCD panel display driver chip foundry. The company competes with international foundries by focusing on mature and specialty process nodes and leveraging its strong domestic market position and technological capabilities. It faces competition from global leaders like TSMC and other Chinese foundries.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Nexchip reported revenue of approximately RMB 9.25 billion, a 27.69% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 532.8 million, up 151.78%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 50.4 billion, with steady growth in operating cash flow. R&D investment accounted for 13.88% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding production capacity and product diversification.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nexchip emphasizes its comprehensive process technology platforms, including mature and specialty nodes, to provide high-quality, cost-effective wafer foundry services. Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, a diversified product portfolio covering multiple IC types, close customer collaboration, and integration within the Hefei strategic industrial cluster. The company also highlights its commitment to supply chain localization, quality management certifications, and intelligent manufacturing to deliver reliable and innovative semiconductor manufacturing solutions.
